name: USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions
description: Analyzes USD/JPY forward returns (5d, 10d, 20d) following BOJ rate decisions, using Japan call money rate changes as a proxy. Classifies decisions as hikes (rate increased) vs holds (rate unchanged/decreased) and compares median returns and hit rates across horizons.
source:
# USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions
# Proxy: Japan call money/interbank rate (monthly FRED)
# Hike = rate increased MoM; Hold = unchanged or decreased
# Forward returns on USDJPY at 5d, 10d, 20d from new observation date

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Japan call money rate (monthly, sparse on daily bars)
jp_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N')()
jp_rate_val = jp_rate_raw.result

# Detect new observations: raw value is valid only on observation dates
is_new_obs = is_valid(jp_rate_val)

# Current rate level (ffilled for comparison)
jp_rate = ffill(jp_rate_val)

# Previous rate: the rate at the prior observation
prev_rate = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_new_obs, jp_rate_val)

# Classify decision type on observation dates only
rate_change = jp_rate_val - prev_rate
is_hike = is_new_obs and is_valid(prev_rate) and rate_change > 0
is_hold = is_new_obs and is_valid(prev_rate) and rate_change <= 0

# --- Forward Returns on USDJPY ---
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# Filter by decision type
hike_fwd_5d = where(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hike_fwd_10d = where(is_hike, fwd_10d)
hike_fwd_20d = where(is_hike, fwd_20d)

hold_fwd_5d = where(is_hold, fwd_5d)
hold_fwd_10d = where(is_hold, fwd_10d)
hold_fwd_20d = where(is_hold, fwd_20d)

# --- Decision type label for bar chart ---
# Use ternary to create a numeric label: 1 = Hike, 2 = Hold
decision_label = 1.0 if is_hike else (2.0 if is_hold else 0.0)
any_decision = is_hike or is_hold
decision_fwd_5d = where(any_decision, fwd_5d)
decision_fwd_10d = where(any_decision, fwd_10d)
decision_fwd_20d = where(any_decision, fwd_20d)
decision_label_filtered = where(any_decision, decision_label)

# Count events for summary
hike_count_flag = 1.0 if is_hike else 0.0
hold_count_flag = 1.0 if is_hold else 0.0
hike_n = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(hike_count_flag)
hold_n = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(hold_count_flag)

# Hit rates (positive forward return)
hike_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hike_fwd_5d) and hike_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hike_fwd_5d) else hike_fwd_5d)
hike_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hike_fwd_10d) and hike_fwd_10d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hike_fwd_10d) else hike_fwd_10d)
hike_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hike_fwd_20d) and hike_fwd_20d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hike_fwd_20d) else hike_fwd_20d)

hold_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hold_fwd_5d) and hold_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hold_fwd_5d) else hold_fwd_5d)
hold_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hold_fwd_10d) and hold_fwd_10d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hold_fwd_10d) else hold_fwd_10d)
hold_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(hold_fwd_20d) and hold_fwd_20d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(hold_fwd_20d) else hold_fwd_20d)

# Rate change magnitude for event markers
rate_chg_bps = where(any_decision, rate_change * 100)
rate_level = where(any_decision, jp_rate_val)
decision_type_str = "Hike" if is_hike else ("Hold" if is_hold else "")
decision_str_filtered = where(any_decision, decision_type_str)

# --- Output 1: Bar Chart — Median Forward Returns by Decision Type ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does JPY Weaken More After Hikes or Holds?',
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Hold'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Hold'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Hold')
    ]),
    order=1
)(hike_fwd_5d, hike_fwd_10d, hike_fwd_20d, hold_fwd_5d, hold_fwd_10d, hold_fwd_20d)

# --- Output 2: Summary Table — Stats by Decision Type ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BOJ Decision Stats: Hike vs Hold',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Hike', 'Hold'],
        col_headers=['N', 'Median +5d', 'Median +10d', 'Median +20d', 'Hit Rate +5d'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    order=0
)(hike_n, hike_fwd_5d, hike_fwd_10d, hike_fwd_20d, hike_hit_5d, hold_n, hold_fwd_5d, hold_fwd_10d, hold_fwd_20d, hold_hit_5d)

# --- Output 3: Event Markers — Each BOJ Decision ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Decision',
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Decision', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Change (bps)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Level (%)', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDJPY +5d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDJPY +20d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(decision_str_filtered, rate_chg_bps, rate_level, decision_fwd_5d, decision_fwd_20d, any_decision)
